title: Dead unwrap_or_else fallback in truncation after max=0 rejection
description: In contact.rs truncation block (~line 510): truncated.last().map(...).unwrap_or_else(|| since_state.clone()). The fallback branch is dead: max=0 is now rejected at parse time (RFC 8620 §5.6), so max>=1 is an invariant here, and truncated always has at least one element. The comment says so ('so the slice index is always non-zero here') but the dead fallback code remains. Replace with .expect("truncated slice is non-empty: max>=1 established at parse time") to make the invariant explicit and remove dead code.
